import test from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {BrowserAudio} from './audio.ts';import {BrowserCaptureTarget} from './browser-capture-target.ts';
async function environment(run:(f:{audio:BrowserAudio;gains:Array<{gain:{value:number};disconnected:boolean}>;nodes:Array<{port:{messages:unknown[];onmessage:((event:{data:{type:string;buffer:ArrayBuffer}})=>void)|null}}> ;gum:MediaStreamConstraints[];sent:ArrayBuffer[];settings:{echoCancellation:boolean;noiseSuppression:boolean;autoGainControl:boolean};tracks:Array<{readyState:string}>;defer:()=>{resolve:()=>void}})=>Promise<void>){
 const originals=new Map(['window','navigator','AudioContext','AudioWorkletNode'].map(k=>[k,Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(globalThis,k)])),gains:Array<{gain:{value:number};disconnected:boolean}>=[],nodes:Array<{port:{messages:unknown[];onmessage:((event:{data:{type:string;buffer:ArrayBuffer}})=>void)|null}}>=[],gum:MediaStreamConstraints[]=[],sent:ArrayBuffer[]=[],tracks:Array<{readyState:string}>=[];let wait:Promise<void>|undefined,complete:()=>void=()=>{};const settings={echoCancellation:true,noiseSuppression:true,autoGainControl:true};
 class Node{disconnected=false;connect<T>(next:T):T{return next;}disconnect(){this.disconnected=true;}}
 class Worklet extends Node{port={messages:[] as unknown[],onmessage:null as ((event:{data:{type:string;buffer:ArrayBuffer}})=>void)|null,postMessage:(message:unknown)=>this.port.messages.push(message)};constructor(){super();nodes.push(this);}}
 class Context{sampleRate=48000;destination={};audioWorklet={addModule:async()=>{}};async resume(){}async close(){}createGain(){const node=new Node(),value={number:1};Object.defineProperty(node,'gain',{value:{get value(){return value.number;},set value(n:number){value.number=Math.fround(n);}}});const typed=node as Node&{gain:{value:number}};gains.push(typed);return typed;}createMediaStreamSource(){return new Node();}}
 const navigator={mediaDevices:{async getUserMedia(c:MediaStreamConstraints){gum.push(c);const constraints=(c.audio||{}) as MediaTrackConstraints;for(const f of ['echoCancellation','noiseSuppression','autoGainControl']as const){const v=constraints[f];settings[f]=typeof v==='boolean'?v:(v as {exact:boolean}).exact;}const track={readyState:'live',onended:null,stop(){this.readyState='ended';},getSettings:()=>({...settings}),getCapabilities:()=>({echoCancellation:[true,false],noiseSuppression:[true,false],autoGainControl:[true,false]}),getConstraints:()=>constraints,async applyConstraints(c:MediaTrackConstraints){if(wait)await wait;for(const f of ['echoCancellation','noiseSuppression','autoGainControl']as const){const v=c[f];settings[f]=typeof v==='boolean'?v:(v as{exact:boolean}).exact;}}};tracks.push(track);return {getTracks:()=>[track],getAudioTracks:()=>[track]};}}};
 Object.defineProperty(globalThis,'window',{value:{AudioContext:Context,isSecureContext:true},configurable:true});Object.defineProperty(globalThis,'AudioContext',{value:Context,configurable:true});Object.defineProperty(globalThis,'AudioWorkletNode',{value:Worklet,configurable:true});Object.defineProperty(globalThis,'navigator',{value:navigator,configurable:true});const audio=new BrowserAudio(data=>sent.push(data),()=>{});
 try{await run({audio,gains,nodes,gum,sent,settings,tracks,defer(){wait=new Promise<void>(r=>{complete=r;});return {resolve:complete};}});}finally{await audio.dispose();for(const[key,value]of originals){if(value)Object.defineProperty(globalThis,key,value);else Reflect.deleteProperty(globalThis,key);}}
}
test('actual BrowserAudio capture bridge never requests permission; enabling creates a separate input gain',async()=>environment(async f=>{const target=new BrowserCaptureTarget(()=>f.audio.captureBinding());assert.equal(target.snapshot().active,false);assert.equal(f.gum.length,0);assert(await f.audio.enableMicrophone());assert.equal(f.gum.length,1);assert.equal(f.gains.length,2);const binding=f.audio.captureBinding()!;assert.equal(binding.gain.gain.value,1);await target.apply({field:'inputGainPercent',value:50},()=>true);assert.equal(f.gains[0].gain.value,1,'Playback/native mixer gain remains unchanged');assert.equal(f.gains[1].gain.value,.5);f.audio.stopMicrophone();assert.equal(f.tracks[0].readyState,'ended');assert(f.gains[1].disconnected);assert.equal(f.audio.captureBinding(),undefined);assert.equal(target.snapshot().active,false);}));
test('actual worklet transport composes DSP inhibition with PTT gate and never releases a refused hold',async()=>environment(async f=>{f.audio.setTransmitEnabled(false);await f.audio.enableMicrophone();const target=new BrowserCaptureTarget(()=>f.audio.captureBinding()),d=f.defer(),change=target.apply({field:'echoCancellation',value:false},()=>true),packet={data:{type:'microphone',buffer:new ArrayBuffer(1920)}};f.audio.setTransmitEnabled(true);f.nodes[0].port.onmessage!(packet);assert.equal(f.sent.length,0);f.audio.setTransmitEnabled(false);d.resolve();assert((await change).accepted);f.nodes[0].port.onmessage!(packet);assert.equal(f.sent.length,0);f.audio.setTransmitEnabled(true);f.nodes[0].port.onmessage!(packet);assert.equal(f.sent.length,1);f.audio.stopMicrophone();f.nodes[0].port.onmessage!(packet);assert.equal(f.sent.length,1);}));
test('actual desired capture settings survive mute/rearm locally and new permission request requires confirmed values',async()=>environment(async f=>{await f.audio.enableMicrophone();const target=new BrowserCaptureTarget(()=>f.audio.captureBinding());assert((await target.apply({field:'noiseSuppression',value:false},()=>true)).accepted);assert((await target.apply({field:'inputGainPercent',value:70},()=>true)).accepted);f.audio.stopMicrophone();assert(await f.audio.enableMicrophone());assert.equal(f.gum.length,2);assert.deepEqual((f.gum[1].audio as MediaTrackConstraints).noiseSuppression,{exact:false});assert.equal(f.audio.captureBinding()!.gain.gain.value,Math.fround(.7));assert.equal(target.snapshot().settings.noiseSuppression,false);}));
test('actual pending target cancellation stops the current track and cannot restart or unmute on a late API result',async()=>environment(async f=>{await f.audio.enableMicrophone();const binding=f.audio.captureBinding()!,target=new BrowserCaptureTarget(()=>f.audio.captureBinding()),d=f.defer(),operation=target.apply({field:'autoGainControl',value:false},()=>true);target.cancelPending();assert(f.audio.muted);assert.equal(f.tracks[0].readyState,'ended');assert.equal(f.audio.captureBinding(),undefined);assert.equal((await operation).reason,'cancelled');d.resolve();await Promise.resolve();assert(f.audio.muted);assert.equal(binding.current(),false);assert.equal(f.gum.length,1);}));
